label: Anthropic (Claude API)
blurb: Claude via Anthropic's API. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

label: OpenAI (GPT API)
blurb: GPT via OpenAI's API. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY.

label: Google (Gemini API)
blurb: Gemini via Google's API. Needs GOOGLE_API_KEY.

label: OpenRouter (multi-model proxy, OpenAI-compatible)
blurb: OpenRouter — gateway to many providers under one key. Written to the config as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (provider `openai` + api_base). Use publisher/model strings like `qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct` or `meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct`. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

label: DeepSeek (OpenAI-compatible)
blurb: DeepSeek — OpenAI-compatible. Written to the config as provider `openai` + api_base. Use model ids like `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-chat` or `deepseek-reasoner`. Needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

label: Claude CLI — single-shot mode
blurb: Uses the `claude` CLI's own login. No API key needed.

label: Claude CLI — agentic (tooled, sandboxed)
blurb: Agentic Claude CLI — more capable, 5-20x more tokens. Subscription only.

label: Codex CLI — agentic
blurb: Agentic Codex CLI — uses `codex login`. Subscription only.
